title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Strengthening the Construction of the Credit Information Sharing and Judicial Assistance Mechanism
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  China Securities Regulatory Commission

Notice on Strengthening the Construction of Credit Information Sharing and Judicial Assistance Mechanisms

Fa [2014] No. 312

Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all local offices of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, all exchanges, all subordinate units, all associations, and all departments within the Commission:

To promote the construction of the social credit system, the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission have decided to strengthen the construction of the enforcement linkage mechanism and carry out cooperation on credit information sharing. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. The Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission shall strengthen the construction of the credit information sharing mechanism and, through a dedicated network line, realize the sharing of credit information between the national court enforcement case information management system and the capital market integrity database.

2. Through the dedicated network line, the China Securities Regulatory Commission may query information on persons subject to enforcement and information on the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement, and the people's courts may query integrity information on administrative penalties and market prohibition decisions made by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.

Information on persons subject to enforcement includes: the name or title of the person subject to enforcement, identity card number or organization code, enforcement case number, filing date, enforcement court, enforcement subject matter, enforcement status, etc.; information on the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement includes: the name or title of the person subject to enforcement, identity card number or organization code, age and gender (for natural persons), name of legal representative or responsible person (for legal persons or other organizations), obligations determined by effective legal documents, the performance status of the person subject to enforcement, specific circumstances of the dishonest conduct of the person subject to enforcement, the issuing unit and document number of the enforcement basis, enforcement case number, filing date, enforcement court, etc.

3. All units and departments within the China Securities Regulatory Commission system may, in the course of securities and futures regulatory work, based on the queried information on persons subject to enforcement, impose restrictions or constraints on relevant institutions and individuals who refuse to perform obligations determined by effective legal documents in administrative licensing and other aspects in accordance with the law.

4. The China Securities Regulatory Commission shall coordinate with the China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited to provide online investigation and control assistance regarding securities accounts of persons subject to enforcement to the pilot people's courts in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong Province, Fujian Province, and Zhejiang Province. The Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission shall establish a "headquarters-to-headquarters" dedicated online investigation and control line. The dedicated online investigation and control line shall directly connect with the China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited. Each pilot people's court shall, with the aid of the dedicated online investigation and control line, directly carry out investigation and control measures in accordance with the law through the China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited.

Online investigation and control shall be used for the inquiry and freezing of securities accounts of persons subject to enforcement in enforcement cases. No online inquiry or freezing shall be conducted against persons other than the person subject to enforcement who are not subject to enforcement obligations.

Pilot people's courts that inquire into or freeze securities through the dedicated online investigation and control line shall ensure information technology security and properly handle coordination with relevant systems and norms. The freezing of securities by pilot people's courts through the dedicated online investigation and control line shall have the same legal effect as written freezing orders from the people's procuratorates, public security organs, and other people's courts and other legally authorized authorities, and the relevant provisions on freezing in the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Issues Concerning the Inquiry, Freezing, and Deduction of Securities and Securities Transaction Settlement Funds" (Fa Fa [2008] No. 4) shall apply. In case of disputes, the Supreme People's Court shall be responsible for coordinating and resolving them.

After a period of pilot implementation, both parties shall promptly summarize the experience and expand the application of the pilot results.

December 9, 2014
